title: Scene
description: A scene within a chapter. The atomic unit of generation. Each scene has an assigned function, beat sequence, heat level, and a lifecycle state managed by the LangGraph state machine.

book_id.description: Parent book identifier (denormalized for ledger queries).

scene_function.description: Genre-specific scene function from the genre_profile.scene_function_vocabulary (e.g. meet_cute, black_moment, intimate_escalation, revelation, action, transition). Genre modules extend this enum.

lifecycle_state.description: Current state in the LangGraph scene lifecycle state machine. Unspecced → Specced → DirtyDraft → NeedsReview → Approved | RE-PLAN → Final.

pov_character_id.description: POV character for this scene. Must be in character_ids.

character_ids.description: IDs of all characters present in this scene.

beat_sequence.description: Ordered list of beat IDs within this scene.

word_count_target.description: Target word count for this scene.

heat_level.description: Heat level for this scene; must not exceed book heat_level or sensitivity_profile ceiling.

goal.description: What the POV character wants in this scene. Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

conflict.description: What opposes the POV character's goal. Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

outcome.description: How the conflict resolves (yes/no/yes-but/no-and). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

state_delta.description: Changes this scene commits to the continuity bible (character states, ledger events). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

x-act.description: Denormalized act number for ledger queries and context pack injection.
